node.note: Exact retained-record counts are the quantization-free growth measure; heap bytes are reported as observed and are sensitive to GC timing (run with --expose-gc for the deterministic figure). This 180-generation window is BELOW the 360-generation genealogy retention boundary, so pruning is not exercised here; the retention bound itself is tested through generation 1000 by test/long-run-memory.test.js.
